name: AI Crawler User Agents
description: Every known AI crawler and agent user-agent string, with operator, purpose, and robots.txt compliance.

crawlers.description: Crawls content to train OpenAI's models.
crawlers.robotsNote: OpenAI documents GPTBot's IP ranges and states it honors robots.txt disallow rules.

crawlers.description: Powers search-style results surfaced in ChatGPT.
crawlers.robotsNote: OpenAI states OAI-SearchBot respects robots.txt rules.

crawlers.description: Fetches pages a user asks ChatGPT to browse in real time.
crawlers.robotsNote: OpenAI states ChatGPT-User honors robots.txt, though as a user-triggered fetcher it visits single pages rather than crawling.

crawlers.description: Crawls content to train Anthropic's Claude models.
crawlers.robotsNote: Anthropic documents ClaudeBot and states it respects robots.txt directives and anti-circumvention signals.

crawlers.description: Fetches pages on behalf of a user during a Claude conversation.
crawlers.robotsNote: Anthropic documents Claude-User alongside its other agents; it fetches single user-requested pages rather than crawling at scale.

crawlers.description: Indexes content to inform Claude's search-style answers.
crawlers.robotsNote: Anthropic states Claude-SearchBot respects robots.txt directives.

crawlers.description: Crawls and indexes pages for Perplexity's answer engine.
crawlers.robotsNote: Perplexity says PerplexityBot respects robots.txt, but independent investigations (notably Cloudflare's 2024–2025 reports) have observed undeclared fetching that bypassed blocks.

crawlers.description: Fetches a page a user asks Perplexity to browse live.
crawlers.robotsNote: Perplexity's own documentation says Perplexity-User generally ignores robots.txt because fetches are user-requested.

crawlers.description: Controls use of content for Gemini and Vertex AI training, separate from Googlebot.
crawlers.robotsNote: As a robots.txt token rather than a crawler, honoring your directive is its entire function; Google documents it officially.

crawlers.description: Common Crawl's crawler; its dataset is widely used to train LLMs.
crawlers.robotsNote: Common Crawl is a nonprofit with a long public record of honoring robots.txt and crawl-delay directives.

crawlers.description: ByteDance's crawler, used for training its AI models.
crawlers.robotsNote: ByteDance publishes no crawler documentation, and multiple independent reports have found Bytespider ignoring robots.txt; blocking it reliably requires firewall or CDN rules.

crawlers.description: Controls use of content for training Apple's AI models (Apple Intelligence).
crawlers.robotsNote: Apple documents the token officially and honors it via Applebot's crawl infrastructure.

crawlers.description: Crawls content for Amazon's search and AI products, including Alexa.
crawlers.robotsNote: Amazon documents Amazonbot and states it respects robots.txt, including wildcard rules.

crawlers.description: Crawls content to train Meta's AI models.
crawlers.robotsNote: Meta documents the agent and states it respects robots.txt rules.

crawlers.description: Cohere's crawler used for training and grounding its models.
crawlers.robotsNote: Cohere publishes no official crawler documentation, so robots.txt compliance can't be verified; use firewall rules if blocking it matters to you.

crawlers.description: Apple's crawler powering Siri and Spotlight suggestions.
crawlers.robotsNote: Apple documents Applebot thoroughly and honors robots.txt directives.

crawlers.description: Google's generic crawler for research and internal product uses.
crawlers.robotsNote: Officially documented by Google and respects robots.txt like the rest of its crawler family.

crawlers.description: Fetches pages when a Le Chat user's question requires them.
crawlers.robotsNote: Mistral documents the agent and states it respects robots.txt directives.

crawlers.description: Fetches specific links for Meta AI when users share or request them.
crawlers.robotsNote: Meta's own documentation states Meta-ExternalFetcher may bypass robots.txt because fetches are performed on behalf of a user.

crawlers.description: Crawls the web for the Allen Institute's open AI research models.
crawlers.robotsNote: Ai2 documents the crawler and honors robots.txt; as a research nonprofit it has strong incentives to stay compliant.

crawlers.description: Fetches pages to generate DuckDuckGo's AI-assisted answers.
crawlers.robotsNote: DuckDuckGo documents the agent and states it respects robots.txt.

crawlers.description: Crawls and fetches pages for You.com's AI search answers.
crawlers.robotsNote: You.com documents YouBot and states it honors robots.txt rules.

crawlers.description: Huawei's Petal Search crawler, also feeding its AI products.
crawlers.robotsNote: Documented by Aspiegel/Huawei with published IP ranges; states it respects robots.txt and crawl-delay.

crawlers.description: Extracts structured data from pages for customers, including AI companies.
crawlers.robotsNote: Diffbot's bulk crawling honors robots.txt, but customer-triggered, on-demand extraction of specific URLs has been reported to proceed regardless — treat blocks as advisory.

crawlers.description: Crawls images across the web for Hive's visual-AI products.
crawlers.robotsNote: The bot is documented and states it respects robots.txt; blocking it mainly affects image collection.

crawlers.description: Webz.io's crawler; its web-data feeds are sold to AI builders.
crawlers.robotsNote: Webz.io documents the bot and states it honors robots.txt; as a data vendor its compliance is part of its sales pitch.

crawlers.description: Crawler for Timpi's decentralized search index.
crawlers.robotsNote: Timpi publishes limited crawler documentation; compliance reports are sparse. If blocking matters, verify behavior in your logs and back the block with a firewall rule.

crawlers.description: Associated with training Huawei's PanGu large language models.
crawlers.robotsNote: No official documentation exists and independent compliance reports are limited — pair any robots.txt block with a firewall or CDN rule if opting out matters to you.
